dataset.description: This dataset is generated during the evaluation of the anti-washout properties of injectable octacalcium phosphate (OCP)-forming cement biomaterials. It includes experimental parameters and assay results obtained from cohesion and washout tests under simulated physiological conditions.

distribution.title: The data are collected to assess the resistance of the injectable OCP-forming cement to disintegration when exposed to aqueous environments, which is critical for maintaining material integrity during clinical application in bone repair.

dataset.title: Evaluation of anti-washout properties of OCP-forming injectable cement

dmp.description:
This project will produce interdisciplinary data in materials science, chemistry, and cell biology arising from the development and evaluation of ready-to-use injectable octacalcium phosphate (OCP)-forming cement biomaterials for bone repair. The data will support optimization of the cement formulation and assessment of key performance parameters, including injectability, anti-washout resistance, setting behavior, porosity, degradation, and biocompatibility.

Types of data generated
Formulation data: composition parameters (liquid type and concentration, solid/liquid ratio), mixing conditions, syringe/needle specifications.
Characterization data: XRD (phase composition), FTIR (structural analysis), Gillmore needle (setting time), SEM (morphology), rheometry/mechanical testing (injectability and viscoelastic properties), cohesion/anti-washout assays, mass loss (degradation), and surface wettability measurements.
Biological data: in vitro biocompatibility and cell–material interaction results.
Documentation: experimental protocols, raw and processed data, instrument output files, images, and statistical analyses.
